name: sine-drift-3d
description: An interactive 3D mathematical sine wave retro arcade game in a single 3KB Data URI with procedural audio, day/night cycles, and drone dodging. Built for Hack Club Bites.

scripts.dev: node -e "import('http').then(h => h.createServer((req, res) => { res.writeHead(200, {'Content-Type': 'text/html'}); res.end(require('fs').readFileSync('dist/index.html')); }).listen(8080, () => console.log('Serving Sine Drift 3D on http://localhost:8080')));"

author: Hack Club Builder
